steps.content: Almost a whole day has passed. The closer to the destination, the worse the contamination and the more fights with Corruptors. The Hypercube reserves are being depleted quickly.
Hecate has been left with the injured. Not as a fighter protecting the wounded, but as someone who needs protecting.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: Yo, don't force yourself to fight, our little burden. Leave it to your big sister Corso, got it?

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Don't go. Using Nightmare to fight is too demanding for you now. I'll protect you. I'll be using my gun only. I won't get contaminated.
She's already heard the same words too many times today. It makes her feel repressed and almost humiliated, and the shackles are making it even worse.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I don't need your protection... I don't want...
With a loud boom, the ground shakes. Then it's all quiet outside. Hecate senses an extremely powerful force.

steps.speaker: Corso
steps.content: F*** me! What the h...

A scream rips the silence. Hecate leaps up and rushes out. The tunnel is a mess, but the battle has long ended. Corso is suspended in mid-air, wrapped in a black substance, whimpering through her muffled mouth.
The surrounding refugees are all clapping and cheering, looking at a petite girl in black with hero-worshipping eyes.

steps.speaker: Refugee
steps.content: It's the Shadow Guardian of West District! We're safe!
The tiny hero stares coldly at them, then turns to leave.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: You're Crache... right? Long time no see. Thanks, you're a lifesaver.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: It's hard to get messages out these days. I wasn't expecting any help, let alone from you. Thank you.

Crache, S-Class Sinner, nominal leader of the Homeless, a Syndican group. After the ten-day uprising, she contacted the Drifter Camp through Ica and joined the camp with all the kids from the Homeless. Since then, she has been secretly protecting the safety of the refugees.
Rumor has it that she's very hostile toward adults... That must have been exaggerated. Matilda thinks this kid simply doesn't like to talk.
But she indeed seems much more mature than her peers. Despite her immense power, she keeps a low profile and always looks quite broody.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...Some fishy guy's been poking around the base. I noticed and followed him here.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: He's blond, and also an Executive Officer. So I thought... you might know him.
Crache glances at Matilda, who understands her meaning.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Got it. Can you tell me where he is?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: He...
As she speaks, she catches sight of Hecate rushing out of the crowd.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: ...What's that one doing here? I thought they sent her back last time?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Your name is Hecate, right? Hey, you...
Completely ignoring Crache's greeting, Hecate darts off in another direction. The squatting figure in the corner is startled by the approaching girl and smiles a little awkwardly.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Hey, if it isn't little Hecate?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Donald!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Shh... Keep it down, I've got a few adversaries... I mean, admirers over there. If they spot me, I'll have a hard time getting away.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Look at these dark circles and bony arms. It's only been two months, or three? Did you get bullied? I'll give those suckers hell later, but first, give me your hand.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I brought you a gift. In return, could you do me a favor and deliver a message for me? It's for...
As the man reaches into his pocket with a grin, Hecate urgently grabs his sleeve, and the object in his hand falls to the ground.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Is it news about Chief? Did you find Chief?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ...I'm sorry to disappoint you. It's just a piece of fruit candy.

With a smile, the man picks up the candy and places it in the disappointed girl's palm. Hecate wants to say something, but she notices a change in Donald's expression. Suddenly, a long stick lands on her shoulder, aiming at the man who is trying to escape.
It's a rifle. She hears Matilda's voice behind her.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Alright, Hecate, this man is a spy sent by the Executive Officers to probe for intelligence. We'll take him. I'll personally interrogate him.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: He and I have a lot to catch up on.
